title: Fits the irobot braava perfectly
text: Fits the irobot braava perfectly. These pads fit my irobot braava perfectly and did a much better job than the disposable pads...much less streaking....I have not washed them on the washer yet but they feel very durable

description: MXZONE 6 Pack Washable and Reusable Mopping Wet Pads for iRobot Braava Jet m6 (6110) (6012) (6112) Ultimate Robot Mop

Durable and Reusable The washable wet mopping pad is made of wicking fibers for effective cleaning and breaks down sticky dirt and kitchen grease in spot clean mode. Use premium microfiber to capture dirt, dust and pet hair.   Deep-Cleaning Microfiber The power of microfiber removes and absorbs tough dirt and grime.  Easy to Install  Efficiency replacement mopping pads are easy to install, reusable, durable and washable. These M6 mop pads are great for your daily cleaning of home/house/room/kitchen/office floor cleaning.
6 x Wet Mopping Pads 1 x Cleaning Brushes (Gift)

Recommend wash by hand and air dry(the mop pads contain a plastic board to keep the microfibers in tact. It is not recommended to place plastic of any kind in the dryer).  Recommended to replace every 3-6 months.
